# Data Science Minor (CMSC)
Source: https://academiccatalog.umd.edu/undergraduate/colleges-schools/computer-mathematical-natural-sciences/computer-science/data-science-minor/
Fetched: 2026-09-28

## Catalog requirements

A grade of C- or better is required for all DATA minor course requirements. Students must take DATA100, STAT100, MATH135, or any 400-level STAT course as a prerequisite for the minor.
Course | Title | Credits
DATA110 | Applications of R for Data Science | 1
DATA120 | Python Programming for Data Science (Python Programming for Data Science) | 1
DATA200 | Knowledge in Society: Science, Data and Ethics (Best Practices for Big Data Collection and Analysis) | 3
DATA250 | Discrete Mathematics (Discrete Mathematics) 1 | 4
DATA320 | Introduction to Data Science 2 | 3
DATA350 | Data Visualization and Presentation (Data Visualization and Presentation) | 3
DATA400 | Applied Probability and Statistics I 3 | 3
Total Credits | 18
